title: Verify technician names match the staff records across Work Orders views
custom_preconds:
Purpose

Verify that technician names on Board View cards, Board column headers and Tech View group headers match Settings → Staff and the List → Lead Technician column.

Preconditions

  1. Log in with permission to view work orders.
  2. Use a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  3. Have two active technicians at the selected location: Technician A is the lead technician; Technician B is assigned to a work order line.
  4. Prepare an approved work order with two approved service lines. Assign Technician A as the lead technician and Technician B to the second line through Edit Line. Use an account with work-order edit permission to prepare this data.
  5. Configure the views: List — show the Lead Technician column; Board View — enable Lead technician and Line technicians under Fields to display; Tech View — show the Assigned Techs column.

Test data note

Use the technicians’ actual names. Staff names and sign-in account names do not need to differ.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings → Staff. Note the names of Technician A and Technician B.
  2. Open Work Orders → All. Clear Search and Status selections, remove the Asset on Site filter, and turn Assigned to me off.
  3. Search for the test customer and switch to List. Check the work order’s Lead Technician column.
  4. Switch to Board View. Check the lead technician’s name on the work order card.
  5. Check the Board column header containing the work order.
  6. Hover over the line-technician avatars on the card, including any overflow indicator.
  7. Switch to Tech View. Check the group header containing the work order.
  8. Hover over the avatars in the work order’s Assigned Techs cell, including any overflow indicator.
custom_expected:
Expected results by step

Step 1: Both staff records are available. Their displayed names provide the reference for this test.

Step 2: The test work order is available.

Step 3: It shows Technician A’s name exactly as recorded in Settings → Staff.

Step 4: It matches Technician A’s staff record name and the List’s Lead Technician name.

Step 5: It shows Technician A’s staff record name.

Step 6: Technician A and Technician B can each be identified by name.

Step 7: It shows Technician A’s staff record name.

Step 8: Technician A and Technician B can each be identified by name.

Pass criteria

  • The List’s Lead Technician name, Board card lead name, Board column header and Tech View group header match Technician A’s staff record name.
  • Both involved technicians are discoverable by name through the avatar groups.

Scope clarification

S5-R11b specifies staff record names for cards and headers. S7-R6 requires every involved technician to be discoverable by name. It does not explicitly specify the underlying name source for Tech View row-avatar tooltips.

If staff and account names are identical, proceed with the test. This verifies displayed-name consistency; it does not establish which underlying field the application reads.

References

PRD: Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options, version 53. Requirements: S5-R11b, S7-R1 and S7-R6. Epic: SV-10043. Story: SV-10048.

title: The lead of an Invoiced or Paid work order cannot be changed by any route
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 45 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Two eligible technicians at this location: [Tech-A] "Esther Howard" and [Tech-B] "Ralph Edwards". A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Invoiced Paid Locked" (used by this case only), with a contact, and six work orders whose Lead Technician was set while they were still open: [WO-1] Approved, led by [Tech-A] · [WO-2] Invoiced, led by [Tech-A] · [WO-3] Paid, led by [Tech-A] · [WO-4] Invoiced, no lead · [WO-5] Declined, led by [Tech-A] · [WO-6] Complete, led by [Tech-A].
  • The technician names are used in the expected results and stay as written; the work order numbers are examples.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] = "Esther Howard" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it), [Tech-B] = "Ralph Edwards" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it).
  4. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Invoiced Paid Locked" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. How to reach each status (standard steps): Estimate = a new work order whose lines are not approved. Approved = approve its lines. In Progress = a technician clicks Start time clock on an approved line's Labor row. Review = set the work order to Ready for Review with its status control. Complete = enter a tech story on every line, complete each line, then complete the work order. Invoiced = Finance tab > Create Invoice (the work order needs a contact person). Paid = record a full payment on that invoice. Declined = decline the estimate.
  6. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Invoiced Paid Locked" (Lead Technician set while they are still open; while a work order is an Estimate its lead is set from Board View: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign). Work Orders > Create Work Order > pick the Customer and its Asset > Save; in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results). Write down each number:
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Approved, Lead Technician [Tech-A].
    • [WO-2] (the expected results call it "S1-511"): led by [Tech-A], then taken to Invoiced.
    • [WO-3] (the expected results call it "S1-366"): led by [Tech-A], then taken to Paid.
    • [WO-4] (the expected results call it "S1-512"): no lead, taken to Invoiced.
    • [WO-5] (the expected results call it "S1-359"): led by [Tech-A] while an Estimate, then declined.
    • [WO-6] (the expected results call it "S1-420"): led by [Tech-A], then taken to Complete.
  7. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Invoiced Paid Locked" shows the six work orders with the statuses and leads listed above. If not, fix the status or lead before starting; then clear the search.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Invoiced Paid Locked" in Search.
  3. Drag the Invoiced card [WO-2] from [Tech-A]'s column into [Tech-B]'s column.
  4. Drag [WO-2] into the Unassigned column.
  5. Drag [WO-2] within [Tech-A]'s column to above [WO-1].
  6. Repeat steps 3 to 5 with the Paid card [WO-3].
  7. Drag the unassigned Invoiced card [WO-4] into [Tech-A]'s column, then drag it to a new position within the Unassigned column.
  8. Drag the Declined card [WO-5] into [Tech-B]'s column (keep shifts if asked).
  9. Drag the Complete card [WO-6] into [Tech-B]'s column (keep shifts if asked).
  10. Open [WO-2] and try to change Lead Technician on the work order page.
  11. Pick Tech View and repeat steps 3 to 7, then drag [WO-5] and [WO-6] from [Tech-B]'s group back into [Tech-A]'s group.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • "S1-511" and "S1-366" cannot be moved to Ralph Edwards or to Unassigned: the card returns to Esther Howard's column and the lead stays Esther Howard.
  • "S1-511" and "S1-366" can be moved within Esther Howard's column and keep their new position. "S1-512" cannot be moved out of Unassigned but can be reordered inside it.
  • The Declined "S1-359" and the Complete "S1-420" move to Ralph Edwards normally ("Lead technician updated").
  • On the work order page the Lead Technician of "S1-511" cannot be changed either. A change sent outside the screens is also refused by the server; this part cannot be checked by hand, write 'server refusal not checked by hand' in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see. Imported work orders are checked in their own case.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R10, S4-N2, Key decision: lead locked once Invoiced or Paid, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions DR-37 (Declined and Complete move freely). PO answer to engineering, Sasha Grosman 24 Sep 2026 (Invoiced/Paid reorder within their technician or within Unassigned). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R10: “Enforce the prohibited-status rule in S4-N2 on every lead-change path, including requests that bypass interface controls.”
  • S4-N2: “Do not allow the lead technician to change in Invoiced, Paid, or Imported status. An Invoiced or Paid work order can still be dragged to reorder it within its current technician (or within Unassigned), but it cannot be moved to another technician, to Unassigned, or out of Unassigned. Declined and Complete work orders can be moved freely, as today.”
  • Key decision: lead locked once Invoiced or Paid: “Lead technician cannot be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid. This is a product rule, not only a screen rule, so it must hold on every path that changes the lead technician — board drag, Reassign dialog, and the work order detail page.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

title: Invoiced and Paid work orders can only be reordered within their technician
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 30 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock Charlie Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock Delta Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock Echo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock Golf Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Alpha Co", "Bravo Co", "Charlie Co", "Delta Co", "Echo Co", "Golf Co").
  • Work orders with lead Ana: Alpha Co Approved, Bravo Co Invoiced, Charlie Co Paid, Delta Co Declined, Echo Co Complete. With no lead: Golf Co Invoiced.
  • None of these technicians has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders (check the Schedule page). If a window titled "Clear … scheduled shifts?" still appears during a move, click "Keep shifts".

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock Charlie Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock Delta Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock Echo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock Golf Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  3. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click Mark Reviewed, enter the VIN if asked and click Confirm Review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co"). Invoice Golf Co without setting a lead.
  4. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock" in Search — exactly 6 work orders show: Alpha Co Approved, Bravo Co Invoiced, Charlie Co Paid, Delta Co Declined, Echo Co Complete (all led by Ana), and Golf Co Invoiced with no lead. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced Lock" in Search so only this case's work orders show.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  4. Look at the Bravo Co and Charlie Co cards and hover the lock or any marker on them.
  5. Drag the Bravo Co card above the Alpha Co card inside Ana's column and release.
  6. Drag the Bravo Co card into Ben's column and release.
  7. Drag the Charlie Co card into the Unassigned column and release.
  8. Drag the Golf Co card from Unassigned into Ana's column and release.
  9. Drag the Delta Co card into Ben's column and release, then drag the Echo Co card into Ben's column and release.
  10. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").
  11. Drag the Charlie Co row into Ben's group and release.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: Bravo Co and Charlie Co show that they can only be reordered within Ana's work, not moved to another technician (the design shows a lock with the text "Invoiced · can't be reassigned"). Write down the words you see where they differ from these; a different label alone is not a fail.
  • Step 5: Bravo Co moves above Alpha Co. Reordering within the same technician is allowed.
  • Steps 6 and 7: Bravo Co cannot be dropped on Ben and Charlie Co cannot be dropped on Unassigned. Both stay in Ana's column, no lead-change message appears and Ana's count is unchanged.
  • Step 8: Golf Co cannot be moved out of Unassigned. It stays there.
  • Step 9: Declined (Delta Co) and Complete (Echo Co) work orders move to Ben's column with "Lead technician updated".
  • Step 11: the same rule holds in Tech View. Charlie Co stays in Ana's group.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-N1, S4-N2, S4-N7, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions page 853901313, DR-37 (25 Sep 2026). Design screen: lock text "Invoiced · can't be reassigned". Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) section 3.23.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-N1: “Apply S4-N1 and S4-N2’s permission and status restrictions to every work order drag.”
  • S4-N2: “Do not allow the lead technician to change in Invoiced, Paid, or Imported status. An Invoiced or Paid work order can still be dragged to reorder it within its current technician (or within Unassigned), but it cannot be moved to another technician, to Unassigned, or out of Unassigned. Declined and Complete work orders can be moved freely, as today.”
  • S4-N7: “Visually indicate that an Invoiced or Paid work order can only be reordered within its current technician, not moved to another one.”
  • Tech plan 3.23 lead lock vs reorder: “In a locked status a work order can be dragged within its current technician (or within Unassigned if it has no lead); it cannot be dropped on another technician, and cannot move between a technician and Unassigned.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

title: A location with no technicians shows only Unassigned in Tech View and Board View
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • A location used only by this case with no technicians in it: e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Empty Shop". No staff member has this location picked in their Location field (Settings > Staff), so no one counts as a technician there; you reach it with Change Location.
  • A person counts as a technician when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and the location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 No Tech Location" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset.
  • Two work orders at the new location for that customer, [WO-1] and [WO-2], with no lead technician.

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Create a location with no technicians: Settings > Locations > New Location > Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Empty Shop"), Address 1, City, State/Province, ZIP/Postal Code, Timezone and Telephone (all required; any test values) > Save & Close. The window notes "Setting up a new location may result in additional billing." Do not pick this location in anyone's Location field (Settings > Staff), so no one counts as a technician there.
  3. Click your initials at the top right > Change Location and pick the new location.
  4. Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 No Tech Location" > Save (if it already exists, open it instead). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, TRK-118) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 No Tech Location" and its asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; the build offers only ready-made lines), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close; the work order becomes Approved. Repeat for two work orders in all; record the numbers as [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-901") and [WO-2] (the expected results call it "S1-902"). They have no lead technician (numbers on this site look like "S10043-17581").
  6. Check the setup worked: the top bar next to the bell shows the new location; Work Orders > All tab lists [WO-1] and [WO-2] with an empty Lead Technician. If other work orders or a technician show at this location, use a fresh location.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (tooltip "Tech View").
  4. Read what the page shows.
  5. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (tooltip "Board View").
  6. Read what the page shows.
custom_expected:
